description: React component for a modal dialog allowing users to flag (quarantine) a post message, including selecting a reason and adding comments.

methods.name: noop
methods.description: No-operation function used as default callback.

methods.name: FlagPostModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering a modal for flagging a post, managing state and form validation.

methods.name: handleOptionChange
methods.description: Handles change in reason selection, updates state and error messages.

methods.name: handleCommentChange
methods.description: Handles change in comment textbox, updates state and error messages.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates form inputs, sets error messages, returns boolean indicating errors.

methods.name: handleConfirm
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls API to flag post, manages loading state and errors.
